prompts.name: Sailor
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / production game sprite animation sheet. Reference image 1 gives the three existing girls' identities and cartoon art style. Reference image 2 shows the current BROKEN implementation: DO NOT copy its standing pose or extra arm. Replace it with an anatomically correct seated fishing pose. Create a clean transparent PNG SPRITE SHEET with EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 3 equal rows on a square canvas, preferably 2048x2048. Every cell contains ONE complete integrated character AND her fishing rod. NO boat, no water, no labels, no grid lines, no backgrounds, no shadows outside the sprite. Same girl identity, proportions, outfit, skin tone, style, scale and seated hip position in all 9 cells. Bold navy cartoon outline, soft warm cel shading, friendly normal human face matching the references. All characters face LEFT in a natural three-quarter side view. She is genuinely SITTING on an invisible horizontal boat bench: hips resting at 66% of cell width and 70% down the cell; bent knees point toward the LEFT, thighs near horizontal and shins tuck down naturally, compact seated silhouette. Both hands properly hold a fishing rod and reel in front of her at the LEFT. Exactly two arms and two hands; arms connect naturally at the shoulders. The fishing rod is integrated into the same drawing, always extends diagonally toward the UPPER LEFT with tip at about 15% of cell width and 10% down. NO fishing line or hook. IMPORTANT: no rod across her face or through her body. Eyes and face fully unobscured. Keep her pelvis at the exact same point in all cells, so frame changes do not slide or jump. Keep all extremities and rod inside their own cell with at least 7% transparent padding. ROWS control hairstyle: row 1 brown double braids with small orange ties, row 2 a neat chestnut chin-length bob, row 3 brown high ponytail. Hair is fully drawn as part of the character, not an overlay; no hats. COLUMNS control pose: column 1 seated relaxed fishing, both hands holding rod and reel at waist height; column 2 seated casting, shoulders and elbows lift a little but her bottom stays on the bench and the rod still leans upper left; column 3 seated reeling, one hand holding the grip, the other naturally turning the reel, slight forward lean. One coherent whole sprite per cell, with complete head, face, hair, torso, bent legs, both hands and rod. Real transparent alpha. No floating heads or limbs, no standing legs, no squashed standing body, no extra limbs. Outfit for this entire sheet: the LEFT girl in reference 1: orange life jacket over blue-and-white striped long sleeves, charcoal pants, olive boots.
